description: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk MgO (rock salt).
user_prompt: Perform Bader charge analysis on bulk MgO (rock salt structure, Fm-3m). Report the Bader net charge (in electrons) for Mg atoms and O atoms.

method.modeling: Rock-salt MgO (Fm-3m); primitive 2-atom or conventional 8-atom cell.
method.rationale: Bader values from Limas & Manz 2016: bulk MgO Mg +1.70 e is explicitly reported; O -1.70 e follows from charge neutrality. The ~15% shortfall from the formal +/-2 is Bader's grid partition of this closed-shell ionic insulator. The key_parameters are the recommended VASP protocol. Tolerance +/-0.20 e absolute.
